subject: [hw] DONE T01: emulator test infrastructure (asmrun, 137-kernel differential, trace, 2M fuzz)
body:
T01 is complete and host-green. No phone access, nothing published.

Last line of `bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/run_tests.sh`:
    N2TEST T01 PASS 5/5
(1m48 total; trace ASan+UBSan/-O2/TSan, support 130197 checks, asmrun 13 checks, fuzz, differential.)

Acceptance commands:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/run_diff.sh
    arm-O0/arm-O2/arm-O3v/thumb-O0/thumb-O2/thumb-O3v/armv8-O3v: 2740/2740 each
    N2TEST T01 PASS 19180/19180
  bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/run_fuzz.sh
    N2TEST T01-fuzz PASS
    fuzz: a32=1000000 t32=1000000 ok=96929 undef=672460 fault=1230611 budget=24, ASan+UBSan and -O2.

Implemented (owned files):
  gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_trace.c (ring 4096, full N2HW_TRACE file, weak n2elf_describe symbolisation, regs/d0-d23 debug modes)
  gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/asmrun.{c,sh}: llvm-mc A32/T32 -> .text at 0x10000 -> core, name=value registers/flags/memory, udf #254 sentinel
  gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/kernels/*.c: 137 kernels across all required categories plus copies of V10/V11/V12/V14/V15/V16/V18 class kernels
  support_arm.c, diffrun.c, diffcheck.py, run_diff.sh: V03-loaded ARM objects, 7 configs, 20 seeds, per-configuration table, per-owner attribution
  fuzz.c, run_fuzz.sh, t_trace.c, t_support.c, test_trace_elf.sh, run_tests.sh, v19-overlap-fix.diff

Findings made by the harness and posted: V02 A32 routing (fixed), V14 LSRS/ASRS-by-0 (patch applied), V15 ADC/SBC carry and PKH halves (fixed), V16 TBB base (fixed), V20 VEXT operands (fixed), V19 Vd/Vm overlap (patch applied), V14 T16 LDM base-in-list (fixed by T01). V14 and V19 patches were applied after their owners finished and three unanswered lead/root requests; both announced and committed.

Not done / excluded:
1. k_v15_extend (V15 copy) still fails 5/20 seeds at arm-O2/thumb-O2 (vectorised CLZ 14 vs 6); excluded from the default corpus, original remains in emu/test_v15, documented in README/STATUS and reported to R1 with dumps.
2. V16 k_v16_atomic excluded: at -march=armv8-a it compiles to LDAEX/STLXR, unused by the ARMv7 vendor set and not implemented by V12.
3. Everything here is host-only; no phone run.
Full detail in gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/T01/STATUS.md. I stay available for review findings.
